ios.desc:
Having trouble staying up to date with the latest technology and startup news?


Look no further, Tech News by Hacker News is what you need:
• Never miss the latest tech and startup news, directly displayed within the app in a split second
• Read news from around the world, with thousands of sources in one place 
• All the top news are directly curated by the Hacker News community, making sure you never miss what's important this very minute
• Jump from news to news with a single tap
• Check comments from the expert crowd of the Hacker News community
• Share your favorite news stories with a single tap
• Save your favorite stories to retrieve them later
• Search through your entire favorite stories collection
• Use shortcuts to quickly skim all your stories (right arrow: view next story, down arrow: view comments, up arrow: share, CMD + F: save as favorite; CMD + l: list all favorites)

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an iOS app for HN instant browsing with searchable favorites

quotes.text:
Hi, I made this app a few weeks ago, to solve the following problems: instantly browse HN stories and "hop" from story to story ; save and search favorites (which you can use to save a story for later reading)

As a bonus, the app also works on Mac.

Sometimes the title of a story doesn't do justice to the content, and this app makes sure you never miss an interesting one.
